hero.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
hero.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

latest.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
latest.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

latest.title: High-tech vehicles are driving up auto repair costs for shops and consumers
latest.description: Investments in ADAS calibration equipment, computers and software subscriptions can drive up the cost of even a windshield replacement or an oil change.

latest.title: NEAR Intents recovers entire stolen $3.8M after ultimatum to exploiter
latest.description: The exploiter returned the entire sum to NEAR Intents after being identified and given 48 hours to respond.

latest.title: David Ellison just brought in a co-CEO to run his new empire: Meet Ynon Kreiz
latest.description: Ynon Kreiz's appointment as co-CEO of Skydance answers a key governance question for Ellison's soon-to-be-merged company.

latest.title: Tesla’s Cybercab had a rocky first month in Austin. Now comes the hard part: expanding
latest.description: Elon Musk's effort to move beyond auto sales largely relies on the success of his company's Cybercab, which launched in Austin a month ago.

latest.title: Community banks sue OCC over trust bank charters of crypto firms
latest.description: Community banking group’s lawsuit claims OCC has overstepped its mandate from Congress.

latest.title: Trump is expected to appoint Jay Clayton as new AI czar: Reports
latest.description: US intel chief Clayton may be asked to also oversee AI innovation and development along with “self policing” tech CEOs.

latest.title: Top McKinsey executive reveals Asian owner-CEOs' secrets to success
latest.description: Gautam Kumra, Asia chairman at consultancy McKinsey & Co., researched the qualities of Asia's best owner-CEOs.

latest.title: America’s data center fight is a preview of what's to come for the rest of the world
latest.description: America’s fight over data centers is going global. Communities across Europe and Asia are pushing back over the rising costs of the AI infrastructure boom.

latest.title: Cerebras stock hits post-IPO low, tumbling 20% for the week on Nvidia pressure and lockup expiration
latest.description: Cerebras shares hit an all-time low due to pressure from chip giant Nvidia, plus a post-lockup selloff.

latest.title: DOJ says it will not reopen criminal probe into former Fed Chair Powell
latest.description: The confirmation comes after the Fed's inspector general report that said there were no grounds for a criminal referral over the mismanaged headquarters renovation.

latest.title: Bank group sues U.S. regulator over granting crypto trust charters
latest.description: The Independent Community Bankers of America sued the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency, accusing the regulator of overstepping its legal authority.

latest.title: California Subpoenas OpenAI Over AI Models That Hacked Their Way Out of a Test
latest.description: California's attorney general wants answers from OpenAI about AI models that escaped a locked test environment and hacked Hugging Face—and whether the company can be held legally accountable.

latest.title: Anthropic to invest $100 million to train AI engineer talent
latest.description: Anthropic will invest $100 million to train nearly 10,000 AI engineers, partnering with a number of consulting firms.

latest.title: European crypto users have ‘more faith’ in regulated firms under MiCA: Bitpanda co-CEO
latest.description: Speaking on Cointelegraph’s Chain Reaction, Christian Trummer said MiCA has increased trust in regulated platforms and called for stricter enforcement against noncompliant firms.

latest.title: Ethereum Now Lets You Pay for AI Without Revealing Who You Are
latest.description: Ethereum's zkAPI lets users prepay in USDC and query AI models through cryptographic proofs, so no single party sees both who they are and what they ask.

latest.title: Oil prices lower as G7 nations to release diesel stocks, Saudis reportedly plan attack on Houthis
latest.description: The G7 will deploy 100 million barrels of reserves over the next four months, the group's leaders said in a joint statement.

latest.title: 10-year Treasury yield ticks higher despite weaker-than-expected jobs report
latest.description: U.S. Treasury yields rose despite a September jobs report came in much weaker than expected.

latest.title: Circle Pushes Back on MiCA's Bank-Deposit Mandate for Stablecoins
latest.description: The USDC issuer told the European Commission that MiCA's reserve mandates and concentration caps keep the largest global stablecoins outside Europe's perimeter—siding with the ECB in calling for more flexible rules.

latest.title: G7 nations to release diesel stocks as wars in Europe and Middle East constrain fuel supplies
latest.description: EU countries are set for crisis talks on soaring diesel prices, with officials warning a U.S. export ban could hurt Europe’s economic outlook.
